extracted.name: Parmesan Potato Bites
extracted.description: These make a great appetizer or side dish. Very easy to make and doesn't take long to bake. #GlobalApron #Parmesan #sidedishes #potatoes
ingredient_lines: 1 bag small potatoes (I like the melody with red and white)
instruction_lines: Place the butter in the pan where you cook the potatoes. Place in oven and preheat to 375 degrees. Meanwhile, add flour, cheese salt, and pepper to a zip-lock bag. Shake Well

Cut each of the little potatoes in half. Dip potatoes in water then in batches add to the zip lock bag and shake. Once the butter has melted and oven is pre-heated add potatoes. Cook one side for 15-20 min.
After 20 minutes, they will look like this. Flip and cook for 20 minutes longer.
